blazers.pulse: Portland is 2-0 after a 128-120 comeback win in Sacramento. It wasn't pretty, though: Blazer's Edge called it a shaky outing, and the Kings' bigs and rookie guard did a lot of damage. Fans will take the W and worry about the defense later.
storylines: Deni Avdija led with 26 points, 6 rebounds and 6 assists; Lillard and Toumani Camara had 19 each
Portland came back from 12 down in the first quarter, powered by a 44-point third
Defense was the worry: Sabonis had 27, 19 and 10, and Kings rookie Darius Acuff Jr. scored 33
Next up: at Luka and the Lakers on Tuesday, then home vs. Memphis on Thursday

timbers.pulse: Tonight feels like the last real shot. The Timbers (9-14-7, 34 points) are tied for 11th in the West and winless in seven. They host Charlotte, who can clinch a playoff spot with just a draw, so fans want a win and aren't expecting much.
storylines: Charlotte at Providence Park tonight, 7:30 PT on Apple TV
First-ever Charlotte visit to Portland; Charlotte won the only previous meeting 2-0 in 2024
Kristoffer Velde is the go-to guy as the team's top scorer
Watch Charlotte's Idan Toklomati, who has a club-record 13 goals
Previews are split between a narrow Timbers win and a 1-1 draw

f1.pulse: Ferrari owned Friday in Austin, with Charles Leclerc topping both practices, but Kimi Antonelli was only 0.042s back in FP2. Qualifying is today at 2 PT, and Antonelli can clinch the title in Sunday's race, though he himself puts the odds at about one in 25.
storylines: Antonelli leads Russell by 102 and clinches Sunday with a win if Russell is 9th or lower and Hamilton 5th or lower
Leclerc led FP1 and FP2; Verstappen was 2nd in FP1 and 3rd in FP2
Antonelli lost time early in FP2 to a loose seat that Mercedes had to fix
Russell got a black-and-white warning flag for forcing Leclerc off track; stewards took no further action
